name: Dakar2008's JSON Editor
teaser: JSON Editor to easy edit JSON and JSONC files, possible to batch edit also.
description_html:
An easy to use JSON Editor to edit config files and other json or jsonc files used in SPT, this can also be used for any other json or jsonc files.

There are a couple of shortcuts when editing values, you can example double a value by CTRL+Numpad+ and half it by doing CTRL+Numpad- when you have selected the value you want to change.

to change a value to any number you want you can just double click it to allow editing this.

after editing the file, just right click on it in the left treeview and click save.

Compatible with any version of SPT-AKI

Please be aware of that i have just selected MIT License but i don’t know what license i have made this application under, but you are free to fork it and make changes to it
